impact.operational_improvements: Retained incumbent suppliers in many cases, minimizing transition time for APDerm.

proof_points.statement: Achieved 19% savings on a $6.3M baseline spend.

evidence.quote: Total project savings of $1.2M or 19% on $6.3M in baseline spend over 2 Phases

case_study_packaging.headline: $1.2M run-rate savings across 10 categories
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: APDerm faced fragmented supply base and decentralized purchasing, resulting in unleveraged enterprise-wide purchasing power amid inflationary market conditions.
approach_summary: Conducted comprehensive spend analysis across multiple categories.
Utilized competitive bidding processes and incumbent supplier negotiations.
Leveraged GPO agreements to achieve rapid savings.
Collaborated with stakeholders to ensure business needs were met.
Implemented solutions with minimal operational disruption.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Delivered $1.2M in annual savings by optimizing procurement processes and leveraging enterprise-wide purchasing power.
where_we_were_unique: Data-driven approach with strong stakeholder collaboration.
Ability to leverage existing supplier relationships and GPO agreements.
Minimized disruption by retaining incumbent suppliers.

extraction_notes: Some spend categories have sparse data or unquantified savings.
Billing Services savings are projected and may change upon final negotiation.
Employee Benefits and Path Lab Systems categories were addressed without savings focus.
Discrepancies in savings figures across documents were reconciled using final case study PDF.
